**Fishing** is a core player skill in Hypixel SkyBlock that involves catching items, treasure, and **Sea Creatures** by casting a rod into water or lava [1, 2]. Progressing in the skill grants permanent **Health** bonuses, increased **Treasure Chance**, and the ability to use more advanced gear and encounter tougher mobs [1, 3].

### **Sea Creatures**
Sea Creatures are unique mobs that have a chance to spawn instead of an item catch. They drop specialized loot and grant significant Fishing XP when killed [3].
*   **Catching Mechanics:** Your chance to encounter one is determined by your **$\alpha$ Sea Creature Chance (SCC)** stat [3]. Additionally, **$\anchor$ Double Hook Chance** determines the probability of fishing up two creatures simultaneously [3].
*   **Scaling Difficulty:** As your Fishing level increases, you unlock stronger creatures with better loot [3]. For example, a **Squid** is available at level 1, while the **Lord Jawbus** requires level 45 and "Adept" trophy fisher status [4, 5].
*   **Regional Lists:** 
    *   **Water (General):** Includes mobs like the Sea Walker, Carrot King, and the Legendary Water Hydra [4, 6, 7].
    *   **Crimson Isle (Lava):** Home to powerful mobs like the Magma Slug, Fire Eel, and the Mythic Plhlegblast [5].
    *   **Event-Specific:** Certain creatures only appear during the **Spooky Festival** (e.g., Grim Reaper), **Winter Event** (e.g., Yeti), or the **Fishing Festival** (Sharks) [8-10].
    *   **Other Regions:** Specific mobs are found in the **Crystal Hollows** (Water Worms), **Oasis** (Oasis Rabbit), and **Galatea** (The Loch Emperor) [11-13].

### **Trophy Fishing**
Trophy Fishing is a specialized system conducted in the lava of the **Crimson Isle** [14].
*   **The System:** Players can catch 18 unique types of **Trophy Fish**, each with specific tiers: **Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond** [14]. 
*   **Requirements:** Most fish have unique catching conditions; for instance, the **Slugfish** requires the bobber to be active for 30 seconds, while the **Golden Fish** must be spotted swimming in the lava [15].
*   **Rewards:** Caught fish can be filleted by the NPC **Odger** to receive **Magmafish** [14]. Discovering higher tiers of fish increases your Trophy Fishing level, which unlocks rewards from Odger, better lava fishing rods, and the ability to fish up stronger lava Sea Creatures [14].

### **Backwater Bayou**
The **Backwater Bayou** is a grimy sewer outflow area featuring unique fishing mechanics and loot [16].
*   **Unique Creatures:** This location features a dedicated set of Sea Creatures including the **Trash Gobbler** (Lvl 5), **Banshee** (Lvl 10), **Alligator** (Lvl 20), and the massive **Titanoboa** (Lvl 30) [17].
*   **Junker Joel’s Shop:** The NPC Junker Joel sells unique **Rod Parts** (Hooks, Lines, and Sinkers) specifically themed around the Bayou [18, 19]. Notable items include the **Treasure Hook**, which exclusively allows for item/treasure catches, and the **Junk Sinker**, which increases Treasure Chance in the Bayou but replaces all treasures with junk [18, 19].

### **Fishing "Fortune" and Stat Sources**
While "Farming Fortune" is a single stat, fishing efficiency relies on several distinct stats [20].
*   **$\alpha$ Sea Creature Chance (SCC):**
    *   **Armor:** Progression from **Angler** (+4%) to **Shark Scale** (+10%) and **Magma Lord** (+18%) [21].
    *   **Rods:** Specialized rods like the **Rod of the Sea** (+7%) or the **Hellfire Rod** (+14%) provide major boosts [22, 23].
    *   **Pets:** The **Dolphin** and **Ammonite** are primary sources [21].
*   **$\umbrella$ Fishing Speed:**
    *   Determines how quickly the bobber bites [24]. 
    *   Sources include various rods (up to +180), baits (like **Fish Bait** at +45), and the **Ammonite**, **Dolphin**, or **Flying Fish** pets [21, 23, 25].
*   **$\boxplus$ Treasure Chance:**
    *   Determines the rarity of item catches (Good, Great, or Outstanding) [26].
    *   Increased by Fishing levels (+0.1 per level), **Blessed Bait**, the **Blessing** enchantment, and a **Rare+ Hermit Crab pet** [1, 26, 27].
*   **$\knight$ Trophy Fish Chance:**
    *   Increased by **Hunter Armor** sets (up to +30) and **Odger's Teeth** accessories (up to +4%) [21].
*   **Blazing Fortune:**
    *   A specific attribute found on **Lava Flame Shards** that improves lava fishing yields [28, 29].
